let NextDNS_Parser = () {
    union isfuzzy=true NextDNS_CL,
    datatable(TimeGenerated:datetime, profileId:string, domain:string, root:string, status:string, queryType:string, protocol:string, encrypted:bool, clientIp:string, client:string, tracker:string, deviceName:string, deviceId:string, deviceModel:string, reasons:string, device:dynamic, RawData:dynamic)[]
    | extend TimeGenerated = coalesce(todatetime(column_ifexists('TimeGenerated', datetime(null))), now())
    | extend profileId = tostring(coalesce(column_ifexists('profileId', ''), column_ifexists('profileId_s', '')))
    | extend domain = tostring(coalesce(column_ifexists('domain', ''), column_ifexists('domain_s', ''))), root = tostring(coalesce(column_ifexists('root', ''), column_ifexists('root_s', ''))), status = tostring(coalesce(column_ifexists('status', ''), column_ifexists('status_s', '')))
    | extend queryType = tostring(coalesce(column_ifexists('queryType', ''), column_ifexists('type', ''))), protocol = tostring(coalesce(column_ifexists('protocol', ''), column_ifexists('protocol_s', ''))), encrypted = tobool(coalesce(column_ifexists('encrypted', false), column_ifexists('encrypted_b', false)))
    | extend clientIp = tostring(coalesce(column_ifexists('clientIp', ''), column_ifexists('clientIp_s', ''))), client = tostring(column_ifexists('client', '')), tracker = tostring(column_ifexists('tracker', ''))
    | extend deviceName = tostring(coalesce(column_ifexists('deviceName', ''), column_ifexists('deviceName_s', ''))), deviceId = tostring(column_ifexists('deviceId', '')), deviceModel = tostring(column_ifexists('deviceModel', ''))
    | extend reasons = tostring(coalesce(column_ifexists('reasons', ''), column_ifexists('reasons_s', ''))), device = column_ifexists('device', dynamic(null)), RawData = coalesce(column_ifexists('RawData', dynamic(null)), pack_all())
    | extend EventVendor = 'NextDNS', EventProduct = 'NextDNS', EventSchema = 'Dns', EventSchemaVersion = '0.1.0', EventType = 'DnsQuery'
    | extend Dvc = tostring(deviceName), DvcId = tostring(deviceId), DvcModelName = tostring(deviceModel), SrcIpAddr = tostring(clientIp)
    | extend DnsQuery = tostring(domain), DnsQueryDomain = tostring(root), DnsQueryTypeName = tostring(queryType), NetworkProtocol = tostring(protocol)
    | extend EventResult = iff(tolower(tostring(status)) == 'blocked', 'Failure', 'Success'), EventResultDetails = tostring(status)
    | extend AdditionalFields = bag_pack('ProfileId', tostring(profileId), 'Reasons', tostring(reasons), 'Encrypted', tobool(encrypted), 'Client', tostring(client), 'Tracker', tostring(tracker), 'Device', device)
    | project TimeGenerated, EventVendor, EventProduct, EventSchema, EventSchemaVersion, EventType, EventResult, EventResultDetails, Dvc, DvcId, DvcModelName, SrcIpAddr, DnsQuery, DnsQueryDomain, DnsQueryTypeName, NetworkProtocol, AdditionalFields, RawData
};
NextDNS_Parser
